propositions: Test monkeypatch closure observed_upsert has narrow signature that does not accept keyword-only parameters evidence_sufficient and seeded that production CriterionBank.upsert now requires.
Production code paths record_insufficient, finalizer, and cache seed legitimately pass evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs to upsert, but test stub rejects them with TypeError.

Bedrock arm triggers bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient) that passes evidence_sufficient=False, while anthropic/openai arms gather sufficient evidence and never hit fallback, causing bedrock-only TypeError.
Test stub must forward all keyword arguments via **kwargs to real upsert while preserving source bookkeeping logic to maintain signature parity.
Unit regression test validates that evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs flow through observed_upsert wrapper without TypeError.
